scope: The exact npm gitHead source workspace includes non-Wasm full-node dependencies (including Wasmtime); its 27 full-lock vulnerability matches must not all be attributed to the browser binary. The selected package versions above are additionally confirmed in the actual installed embedded Wasm.
resolution: Remove the unused optional @substrate/connect dependency from its RPC-provider consumer. The existing ScProvider accepts an explicitly supplied client interface, and current operational tooling uses HTTP/WebSocket RPC. No vulnerable light-client binary is shipped through this optional default path.
